title: Zoo Juice
description: A variation on jungle juice, this big batch version called "zoo juice" features vodka, orange punch, citrus-flavored soda, and fresh fruits like strawberries and clementines.
ingredients: 1 gallon orange punch (such as Sunny D®)
1/2 cup cherry-flavored drink mix (such as Kool-Aid®)
1 (2 liter) bottle caffeinated citrus-flavored soda (such as Mountain Dew®)
1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime soda (such as Sprite®)

steps.text: Combine undrained pineapple chunks, strawberries, clementines, and watermelon in a gallon container. Add vodka, stir, and close the lid. Store in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight.

When ready to serve, pour ice into a 10-gallon container. Pour fruit-vodka mixture over the ice. Pour in orange punch and cherry-flavored drink mix. Slowly add caffeinated citrus-flavored soda. Slowly add lemon-lime soda. Stir slowly until combined.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to serve.
